detail.longDescription: I built the tool for local businesses, I know they have the problem: getting one built is easy, but nobody touches it afterwards. Content goes outdated - working hours wrong, photos on the website from 2019 and reviews customers leaving on different platforms are everywhere but not on the website. My tool helps to build website in one click: you type a business name it reads the reviews and photos from Google, Yelp, Tripadvisor and builds a website from them in a few minutes, then it keeps reading and updating contnet constantly - A worker re-reads Google and other platforms on a schedule, stores only what is new, and rewrites the copy - Owners change things by chatting ("make it dark green", "add a page about emergency repairs") A while ago I've also built a bunch of free tools that are on the website and are open source: https://github.com/vaitko/locan-tools I'd like to hear where the generated sites look wrong or generic. Thank you for your feedback!
